settings.value_line: Scheduled feeding, managed from your phone.

settings.image_alt: A cat eating from the black Gavelli WiFi Smart Feeder at home
settings.label: Every day
settings.heading: Mealtimes keep to time,
settings.text: A lie-in, a late train, a long day out. Set the times once in the app and the feeder serves each meal on schedule, so the routine your cat or dog relies on stays the same, whatever your day looks like.

settings.title: Fill and plug in
settings.text: Fill it with your pet's dry food and plug it in. It comes with a UK plug.

settings.title: Connect
settings.text: Add the feeder to the Dingdong app on your phone, over your home's 2.4GHz WiFi.

settings.title: Set mealtimes
settings.text: Choose the times in the app. From then on, the feeder dispenses at each one.

settings.name: Delivery
settings.value: Free to UK addresses, 5–10 working days

settings.question: Which WiFi does it need?
settings.answer: A 2.4GHz network. Many home routers offer 2.4GHz alongside 5GHz; networks that are 5GHz-only aren't supported.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Delivery to UK addresses is free and usually takes 5–10 working days. You'll receive a tracking number once your order is on its way. More in our delivery policy.

settings.question: Can I return it?
settings.answer: Yes. You can change your mind within 14 days of delivery, and if anything arrives faulty, we'll put it right. The details are in our returns policy.

settings.label: Good to know
settings.heading: The details.
settings.contact_note: Something else? Write to us and we'll reply within 24 hours on business days.

settings.heading: One less thing
settings.text: Set the times once. The feeder keeps them.
